channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Donegal v Derry and Offaly v Antrim both postponed
item.description: This afternoon's Dr McKenna Cup first round clash between Donegal and Derry in Letterkenny has been postponed over safety concerns.

item.title: Dowling takes over Naas
item.description: Former Kilkenny U20 boss Mark Dowling has been appointed as the new senior hurling manager of Naas.

item.title: All-Ireland club SFC semi-final gets go ahead after pitch inspection
item.description: This afternoon's All-Ireland club senior football championship semi-final between Scotstown (Monaghan) and St Brigid's (Roscommon) will go ahead as planned at Kingspan Breffni.

item.title: Frozen pitch sees Kildare v Galway postponed
item.description: Kildare's Walsh Cup opener against Galway has become the third of this afternoon's games to fall foul of the freezing weather conditions.

item.title: Dublin and Wexford record first round wins in Walsh Cup as three games called off
item.description: Dublin will play Wexford in the quarter-finals of the Walsh Cup on Thursday evening after both teams secured opening wins in the pre-season competition this afternoon.

item.title: Rossies net five times against Leitrim to mark winning start to O'Dowd reign
item.description: Holders Roscommon cruised to an emphatic 5-17 to 0-14 win over Leitrim in the teams' first outing in the Connacht FBD Football League this afternoon.

item.title: Donegal and Derry share points as postponed McKenna Cup clash won't be re-fixed
item.description: This afternoon's postponed Dr McKenna Cup first round clash between Donegal and Derry will not be re-fixed.

item.title: Former Kildare captain Hyland retires from inter-county duty
item.description: Former Kildare senior captain David Hyland has announced his retirement from inter-county football.

item.title: St Brigid's edge out Scotstown to claim All-Ireland club SFC final spot against Dingle
item.description: St Brigid's booked their place in the All-Ireland club senior football championship final against Dingle thanks to a 1-16 to 1-12 victory over Scotstown before a 4,837 crowd at a freezing cold Kingspan Breffni this afternoon.
